description: One call: create a curated Mother's Day (Mors dag) gift wishlist and return shopUrl (share link) + ownerUrl. Preferred agent path: create a Mother's Day wishlist and add ASINs / keywords / search queries in one call. Returns id, editToken, ownerUrl, shopUrl. OpenAPI: agentCreateAndFill.

itemQueries.description: Each query is searched and added as a wish

locale.description: User locale, e.g. en, sv, de, fr, es (mothers day / mors dag / Muttertag / fête des mères / día de la madre)

marketplace.description: Amazon storefront domain or id for the end user, e.g. amazon.se, amazon.com, se, de. REQUIRED — curated ASINs only produce /dp links on amazon.se; other marketplaces get Mother's Day search deep-links.

name: create_and_fill
title: One-shot create and fill
